tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Report whether this service is up and which version answered. Use it to confirm the endpoint is reachable before running a real job.

tools.name: list_carparks
tools.description: List HDB carpark codes known from the live Singapore data.gov.sg feed (optionally filtered by code prefix).

tools.name: get_carpark_availability
tools.description: Current lots available per lot type for one HDB carpark code (live from data.gov.sg).

tools.name: get_carpark_history
tools.description: Our stored snapshot history for one carpark code (availability sampled since launch). Deterministic read of our own snapshots.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_carpark_history" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
